question: Related Questions Q. What our ulema say about nikah misyar which is popular in saudi arabia which is done as follows- 1. There is an offer and acceptance (Ijab and qabool) 2. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 35647 Country: India Title: Marriage to eunuch, castrated male person, or impotent male person is lawful/correct in Islam Question: . We both husband and wife love each other, but due to some misunderstanding 3 Talaq between us occurred. We did not know about three talaq but I have uttered 7 to 8 times the word talaq. So people said it is 3 talaq. We did not want to separate but not to break the laws of Allah of Halalah. Also some friends suggested us to do this. Since one of the person is eunuch and have sympathy for us would like to help but if Shariah permits. Answer ID: 35647 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1917/1356/L=1432) The nikah of a woman is lawful with a eunuch if he is male; likewise it is valid with castrated male and impotent person. However after three talaqs and after passing iddah, she will not be halal for the first husband until she marries other man and he has intercourse with her and then gives her talaq and she passes her iddah. And it shall not be lawful for the first husband to marry her without fulfilling the above mentioned conditions. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
